newsitem.title: USA: Misonix revises option from 1992 offering.
newsitem.headline: Misonix revises option from 1992 offering.

text.p: Misonix Inc said on Friday it revised the underwriter's options originally granted to Joseph Lyon & Ross Inc as underwriter of its initial public offering in January 1992.

The modification provides for current holders to immediately recieve a total of 140,308 shares, as well as options to acquire an additional 160,000 shares at $6 per share, exercisable through May 31, 1998.
Misonix shares were trading at 9-3/8 on Friday, up almost a point on the day.
The company said it did not expect the modification to result in a charge against earnings.
Misonix makes medical, scientific and industrial ultrasonic and air pollution control systems.
